title: Don't Panic! How I Trade During a Stock Market Crash
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: A hotter-than-expected CPI could lift Fed rate-change odds toward 50% and markets may de-risk ahead of the report.
Brent above $107 on Russia-Ukraine and Middle East escalation; escalations make markets de-risk, de-escalations allow recovery.
South Korean market plunge and China's CXMT server-memory plans weigh on memory names; longer-term DRAM pricing is the bigger risk.

calls.reason: Intraday oversold reversal after buying the dip, but QQQ is overbought near all-time highs with CPI ahead, leaving big pullback potential to prior lows near 700.
calls.quote: we can see this overbought reversal into the lows of 700. We have a big way down to go, right? We're incredibly overbought.

calls.reason: Sell-off tied to South Korean market plunge and China's CXMT server memory plans; long-term DRAM oversupply could undercut Micron's pricing.
calls.quote: this has been a really bearish start to the morning for Micron. So, we'll see if it actually can begin to recover or if it just produces another leg down.

notes: Date from 'Happy Monday' (listing approx 2026-10-13). He also mentions 'pullback potential to the lows of 900' on an unnamed chart (possibly SPY/another index), not recorded. MU 'broke below $1,000' is a garbled transcript line ('I use broke below'); treated as MU and placed as resistance, low confidence. SK Hynix called the weakest memory name but not a US ticker; NVDA/MSFT mentions were news only.
